passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Brachypodium stacei Catalán, Joch.Müll., L.A.J.Mur & T.Langdon.
The native range of this species is Canary Islands, Medit., Ethiopia. It is an annual and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
